defects.problem: 6606-E amends a condition of the approval in held EO 6533 (1933-12-23). Condition 2 of EO 6533 provides 'That my approval of the Code as a separate Code is limited to a period of three (3) months from the effective date thereof' and authorizes the Administrator to place the industry under the Graphic Arts code (approved the same day by EO 6606-B). The amended condition depends on that time-limited separate approval, so an earlier own-terms end (about spring 1934) is a live possibility. The claim never addresses it and asserts no held record ends the code before 1935-06-14. The 1935-06-14 end is not established.
The claim says it searched held texts for the code name, and that search returns EO 6533 with the three-month limit. The claim does not mention it.
